sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Jelly Mash is a match-three puzzle game. Players are presented with a grid filled with colorful jellies, and the objective is to clear the grid by creating chains of three or more matching jellies in a row. Sounds simple, right? Wrong! What sets Jelly Mash apart from other puzzle games is its unique twist on the classic Bejeweled formula. Players must match jellies not only by color but also by shape, type, and even by special power-ups. This added layer of complexity makes the game both challenging and thrilling.

To start playing, simply click on a piece of jelly to swap it with an adjacent piece. You can move jellies up, down, left, or right, but be careful - swapping jellies can create new opportunities for matches, but it can also block potential matches. As you clear the grid of jellies, new ones will rise from the bottom, giving you a new chance to create matches. The game also features a special 'mash' mechanism that allows players to clear multiple jellies at once. This is achieved by matching three or more jellies of the same type in a row, which will then disappear from the grid, leaving space for new jellies to rise from the bottom.

But that's not all - players can also use special power-ups to aid them in their quest to clear the grid. These power-ups can be activated by matching certain combinations of jellies, and they can range from simple things like clearing a single jelly to more complex things like clearing an entire row or column of jellies. With so many different power-ups and special moves at your disposal, the possibilities are endless in Jelly Mash.

The game also features a variety of different level types, each with its own unique objectives and obstacles. Some levels may require you to clear a certain number of jellies within a set time limit, while others may require you to clear specific types of jellies. Whatever the level, the goal is always the same - clear the grid and progress to the next level.

In terms of difficulty, Jelly Mash starts off easy but gradually increases in difficulty as you progress through the levels. The levels become increasingly challenging as you progress, with more obstacles and special moves to contend with. But don't worry - the game also features a helpful tutorial that will guide you through the basics of gameplay and help you learn the ropes.
